description: A Perl script designed for flashing firmware onto a Linksys ADSL2MUE device. It performs network discovery, connects via FTP, and writes firmware data to specified device partitions.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for sending commands and retrieving environment variables specific to the ADAM2 device.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable values from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables via FTP.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a reboot command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to trigger a reboot of the device via FTP.
